title: ErrorOutput
description: Any failure: `{"error": {...}}` (stderr; stdout with an explicit `--format json`).

ErrorCode.description:
Machine-readable errors: `{code, message, hint?, details?}`, with one exit code per class of failure.

| exit | meaning | | --- | --- | | 0 | ok | | 1 | usage (bad arguments, script, selector) | | 2 | check failed (`check` command) | | 3 | bundle failed (Metro) | | 4 | app error (the app threw while loading or rendering) | | 5 | host (missing, unavailable, crashed, timeout) |
